validation.scope: Initial page state; observations are version-specific, not universal tool guarantees.

reset: Reload the URL; no storage or network writes.

issues.title: Demo page with issues
issues.summary: A normal-looking workspace page with the issues below built in. The engine must find every one.

fixed.title: The same page, fixed
fixed.summary: Every issue fixed. Any finding here is a false alarm.

issues.title: The archive button has no name
The help icon link has no name
The search label is not connected to its field
issues.whoItHurts: Screen reader users reach an edit field without knowing what it is for.

issues.title: The usage chart has no text alternative
issues.whoItHurts: Blind users miss the numbers the chart shows.

issues.title: The hint under the chart is too faint
issues.whoItHurts: People with low vision cannot read it.

issues.title: The usage heading is empty
issues.whoItHurts: Screen reader users jumping by heading land on nothing.

issues.title: Workspace settings is a level 3 heading under Projects
issues.whoItHurts: Screen reader users are told settings belong to Projects; they are a peer section.

issues.title: Export report works with a mouse only
issues.whoItHurts: Keyboard users cannot reach or press it.
issues.check: Keyboard (Playwright): Tab through the page; it never gets focus

issues.title: Plan details appear on mouse hover only
issues.whoItHurts: Keyboard and touch users cannot see them.
issues.check: Mouse vs keyboard (Playwright): hover shows it, focus never does

issues.title: Focus is lost after archiving a project
issues.whoItHurts: Keyboard and screen reader users are dropped at the top of the page.
issues.check: Keyboard (Playwright): press Archive, check where focus lands

issues.title: The message after archiving is never announced
issues.whoItHurts: Screen reader users press Archive and hear nothing about what happened.
issues.check: Keyboard (Playwright): press each control, check new text is announced

issues.title: A failed sync says nothing
issues.whoItHurts: Everyone believes the settings synced; screen reader users have no way to find out otherwise.
issues.check: Keyboard (Playwright): press each control, check a failed request is announced
